proof_body:
by
  intro n _ K _ _ _ ζ hζ x
  have hc := IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.isIntegralClosure_adjoin_singleton hζ
  rw [hc.isIntegral_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact y.2
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩
target_source: ∀ (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (K : Type*) [Field K] [CharZero K] [IsCyclotomicExtension {n} ℚ K] (ζ : K), IsPrimitiveRoot ζ n → ∀ x : K, IsIntegral ℤ x ↔ x ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℤ ({ζ} : Set K)
